rationale: p15-chair-s3: Backward straddle pose with arms folded on chair back rail. globalTwist:55 (body twisted toward chair back). Original config: L shoulder -60 (abd 83°), R shoulder -72 (abd -168° outside band), shoulderFwdL/R=+35/+25 (both BEHIND per corrected convention) → arms swing backwards in opposite directions ending on opposite sides of body. FIX: equalize both shoulders at -60 (abd 83° lateral), increase both elbows from 100/95 to 100 (right-angle forearms horizontal), flip both shoulderFwdL/R from +35/+25 to -50 (forward per corrected convention) → both forearms swing forward and converge. After patch: L wrist (0.325, 0.568, 0.576), R wrist (0.652, 0.568, 0.108). Both at SAME y (0.568 — chair rail height) ✓, both forward of torso ✓ (z=0.576, 0.108 both positive), both on figure's right side ✓ (x=0.325, 0.652 — toward chair back in front of twisted body), 0.571 apart (was 1.443 — 60% reduction). L arm abd -30° (slight cross-body to reach chair back on figure's right side — anatomically reasonable for straddle + twist; plausibility flag false-positive for twist). R shoulder flexion -67° (slightly outside band [-60,180], minor). spine=+12 unchanged (chest lifted ✓ slight forward).
